prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally overoptimistic for non-winning tests, but underpredicted gains for winning tests.
sign_in hint changes were helpful, winning 2 of 3 tests.
choose_path copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
home redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence remains thin for all other specific change types as they lack at least 2 agreeing tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +2.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +1.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: -0.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +2.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, copy: +0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

- finish, notification: -0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -6.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

- home, redesign: +0.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Protection Reorder: Move account sign-in to take place immediately after pet adoption certificate creation so users secure their newly named pet right after adoption. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, and adoption drop-off is 34%. Moving sign-in post-adoption anchors pet ownership.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Readiness Countdown Screen: Insert a dedicated pet desktop hatch status screen with interactive progress indicators right before home intro. (why: The waiting stage has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing drop-off before completion.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Interaction Basics Sub-Flow: Add an interactive desktop controls guidance screen after home intro showing how to move, hide, and summon the new desktop pet. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet, while finish conversion is 64.8%.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Retrieval Hint: Display an explicit hint on the sign-in screen informing users that logging into an existing account restores their previously saved pets. (why: 8 support tickets cited pets missing or reset after signing in again. Sign-in hints have a proven track record of winning previous tests.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Rendering Time Estimate Display: Enable time estimates and progress indicators on the waiting screen while desktop pet graphics render in the background. (why: The waiting screen has an average completion time of 2336 seconds, creating uncertainty that causes drop-off.)
5: [finish, notification] Desktop Companion Summon Notification Switch: Add a system notification prompt to the home intro screen that alerts users when their desktop pet finishes loading onto the desktop. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing up on desktop or users not realizing the desktop app had opened.)
6: [adoption, copy] Custom Pet Photo Requirements Guidance Copy: Update the photo upload headline and body copy to explain lighting and background requirements for accurate pet creation. (why: 3 support messages noted that custom pet generation fails or results in incorrect visual pet models.)
